correctness.rationale: The two-map composition criterion is proved by evaluating the moved points; the all-clique/source-target map equivalence and extension criterion are exact, including n=2,3. Surjections yield the stated maximal count. A full invariant direct-sum decomposition of the adjacency operator gives every characteristic polynomial factor and multiplicity. The Lucas identity establishes an infinite integral-spectrum family. Independent finite enumeration n<=7 and integer characteristic polynomials n<=6 corroborate the algebraic proof, without substituting for it.

value.rationale: The results completely classify maximal commuting families of canonical singular-transformation generators and the full adjacency spectrum of their natural induced commuting graph across all cardinalities. Stirling multiplicities distinguish inclusion-maximal from largest cliques, explain the sharp nonpurity transition, and the exact spectral factorization yields connectivity and an infinite Pell/Lucas integral phenomenon. These structural invariants are motivated independently of their computability or novelty.
